01 / iOS · SwiftUI · SwiftData

Elite
Hypertrophy.

Plan the workout. Record the set. Keep the history.

01

Inside a session.

Elite Hypertrophy brings workout planning and live set logging into one iOS app. The logger keeps weight, reps, effort, and rest time together, with progression suggestions based on recorded effort.

Training splits organize sessions. Exercise history and a muscle-volume map help review the work across workouts.

02

Under the interface.

SwiftUI provides the interface and SwiftData stores local workout records. The project also includes progress photos, StoreKit subscriptions, and a research-assisted coach.

Interface
SwiftUI
Local records
SwiftData
Screenshot import
Vision OCR + review
03

A screenshot becomes a workout.

The import workflow uses Apple’s Vision framework to extract text from a workout screenshot. There is a review step before saving the extracted workout, so the user can check the result.

1. Pick a screenshot→2. Extract with Vision→3. Review & save
